text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Trucker's Association of Zambia has urged the Zambia Revenue Authority to stop demanding Value Added Tax from defaulting transporters owed money by the government.
- Three children have died from anthrax in western Zambia.
- The Zambian capital of Lusaka has been declared an environmental disaster because of poor waste disposal systems, an enviromental workshop for parliamentarians said.

- Parliamentarians at an environmental workshop have called for action against the state-run Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) to force it to improve its waste management system, which they said was a health hazard to residents of the Copperbelt province.
- The Investment Centre received investment pledges worth three billion kwacha in 1996, an investment spokesman said.
